description: This is a Python source file for the BORIS (Behavioral Observation Research Interactive Software) project. It contains functions for exporting observation data in various formats, including tabular, aggregated, and event sequences, as well as handling file writing and data processing related to behavioral observations.

methods.name: export_events_jwatcher
methods.description: Exports events in jwatcher .dat format for each subject, creating associated .fmf, .faf, and .fma files with behavior descriptions and event data.

methods.name: export_tabular_events
methods.description: Exports observation events into a tabular dataset, supporting multiple formats and including detailed event and media information.

methods.name: dataset_write
methods.description: Writes a tablib dataset to a file in specified format, supporting pandas, R, CSV, TSV, HTML, ODS, XLS, and XLSX formats.

methods.name: export_aggregated_events
methods.description: Exports aggregated behavioral events for a specific observation, with optional modifier count forcing, returning a dataset and max modifiers.

methods.name: events_to_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Generates a behavioral sequence string for a subject in an observation, based on event start/stop points.

methods.name: events_to_behavioral_sequences_all_subj
methods.description: Generates behavioral sequences for all subjects in an observation, with subject labels.

methods.name: events_to_timed_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Creates a time-sampled behavioral sequence string for a subject with specified precision.

methods.name: observation_to_behavioral_sequences
methods.description: Exports behavioral sequences for selected observations to a text file, including media info and event details.
